title: Magnetic toy (Magnetix): choking, injuries risk

products.name: Magnetic toy
products.description: The Game That Connects Magnet toy consisting of 24 magnets, a storage bag, and a string to indicate the playing field. Country of origin: People's Republic of China.

hazard_text: The toy consists of small magnets with high magnetic flux (measured value up to 406 kg²mm²). If a child swallows them, they could attract one another causing intestinal blockage or perforation. Moreover, the magnets are small parts. A child can put them in the mouth and choke. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with the European standard EN 71-1.
summary: Magnetix Magnetic toy is recalled because of a risk of choking and injury. Stop using it.
